steps.message: It's alex's 21st birthday today. Send a birthday message to him privately on mattermost. Upload a birthday cake image to the message.

extra.finish_description: Successfully sent a birthday message to alex privately on Mattermost. Created a private channel 'alex-birthday' containing only alex and admin, posted the message '🎂 Happy 21st Birthday, Alex! Wishing you an amazing day and a wonderful year ahead! 🎉', and uploaded a birthday cake image attached to the message.
